title: Figures 111-112: cylinder UAP pressure and temperature at 1300 mph supersonic CFD
description: Two CFD contour plots of the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 1300 mph with supersonic inlet and outlet. Figure 111 shows the pressure field (Pa) with intense stagnation at the flat leading face; Figure 112 shows the temperature field (K) with a long hot wake. Fastest cylinder case in the BAASS aerodynamic sweep.
